description: APU offers new international students of all countries and nationalities merit awards that take the form of tuition-fee rebates/discounts. The discount band is fixed by the applicant's final school-leaving results: A-Levels, O-Levels/IGCSE, the IB Diploma and the IB Middle Years Programme each produce 30%, 20% or 10% discounts. Applicants with Sports Excellence (participation at the Olympics, SEA Games, Youth Olympics, Asian Games, World Cups and Commonwealth Games) may be considered for merit awards on a case-by-case basis. All awards leading to fee rebates/discounts are granted on a first-come, first-served basis and may be secured by paying the Application & Processing Fees of RM 3,600 (approx. USD 950). All applicants must meet the minimum entry requirements and maintain a CGPA of 2.50 to enjoy the fee awards in subsequent years; the awards are limited to course/tuition fees only, are not transferable or exchangeable for cash, are valid only for study at APU in Malaysia (not at overseas partner universities), and must be applied for on or before the official deadline of 31 October 2026 with a full set of documents.

programme_structure.renewal_criteria: The official table footnote states: '* Merit Awards are awarded on a yearly basis and are renewable upon meeting minimum CGPA 2.50 at the end of each academic year.' Condition 2 of the official Conditions of the Awards repeats this: 'All applicants must meet the minimum entry requirements & maintain the CGPA of 2.50 in order to enjoy the Fee Awards in the subsequent years (where relevant). Failure to meet such academic requirements will result in the award being terminated/ suspended.'
programme_structure.intake: Rolling across APU intakes but with a single published scholarship deadline of 31 October 2026 and awards granted strictly first-come, first-served, so the practical window closes when the annual award allocation is exhausted

status_label: Open - applications close 31 October 2026 (first come, first served)
status_note: As of the verification date of 10 October 2026 the official page states that the deadline for this International Scholarship & Merit Awards is 31 October 2026 and that the full set of documents must be received on or before that date. Because every award is granted on a first-come, first-served basis and is secured by paying the RM 3,600 Application & Processing Fees, the award pool can be exhausted before the deadline; applicants should not treat 31 October 2026 as a safe final date.
verification_notes: Verified against multiple official apu.edu.my assets: the International Students Scholarships & Merit Awards page (including its markup, to reproduce the discount table exactly), the official APU Scholarships & Merit Award Guide (Aug 2026) PDF, the International Students Application Procedures page (RM 3,600 fee composition and refundability), the Scholarships & Financial Aids overview page, the Merit Scholarships page, and the official APU logo assets on apu.edu.my. The task briefing's proposed deadline of 31 August 2026 was checked and is NOT the current official date: the official page states 31 October 2026. No English-language test score threshold is published anywhere for this award itself (only a general requirement to submit IELTS/TOEFL/PTE/MUET evidence with the international application and visa file), so it is recorded as an unverified item rather than invented.
source_last_updated: The APU Scholarships & Merit Award Guide was issued August 2026 (Scholarships&MeritAwards_Aug2026.pdf). The International Students Scholarships & Merit Awards page shows 2026/2027 final results and is current at the verification date.

application_deadline.deadline_timezone: Malaysia Standard Time (MYT, UTC+08:00) - no time of day is published on the official page
application_deadline.typical_application_window: Open now for the current cycle, closing 31 October 2026. APU advises international applicants in general to apply 6-8 weeks in advance of the scheduled intake because visa processing normally takes 3-4 weeks, which means the practical application window for a given intake is well before the scholarship deadline.
application_deadline.application_period: Applications are accepted up to and including 31 October 2026, provided the full set of documents is received on or before that date.
application_deadline.official_rule: 'The deadline for this International Scholarship & Merit Awards is 31 October 2026. We must receive the full set of documents for scholarship application on or before this date. All Scholarships & Merit Awards are on first come first serve basis.'

programme_duration.official_range: Awards are issued per academic year; the applicant's degree programme follows APU's normal length (bachelor's degrees are normally 3 years)
programme_duration.renewal_note: The discount is granted on a yearly basis and must be re-earned each year by maintaining a minimum CGPA of 2.50 at the end of the preceding academic year; failing this terminates or suspends the award. APU's undergraduate programmes normally run 3 years.

funding.scholarship_type: University-funded tuition fee rebate/discount (merit award) for international students
funding.monthly_amount_note: No monthly stipend or allowance of any kind is published. The award is purely a reduction of tuition fees.
funding.travel_amount_note: No travel grant. Travel expenses are explicitly excluded from the award and must be borne by the award holder.
funding.institutional_costs: The award is limited to course/tuition fees only. Registration fees, accommodation fees, deposits, partner-university fees, resit or retake fees, living expenses and travel costs are all excluded and borne by the award holder.
funding.fully_funded_note: Not a fully funded award. It is a 10-30% reduction of course tuition fees and nothing else, and it does not cover any part of living, travel, registration or accommodation costs.

tuition.percentage_of_annual_tuition: 10%, 20% or 30% depending on the qualification band: A-Levels AAA 30% / AAB 20% / ABB or AAC 10%; O-Levels/IGCSE 8-9 As 30% / 6-7 As 20% / 4-5 As 10%; IB Diploma 34 points and above 30% / 30-33 points 20% / 26-29 points 10%; IB MYP 48 points and above 30% / 44-47 points 20% / 35-43 points 10%
tuition.conditions: Applied as a fee rebate/discount on course tuition fees for each academic year in which the minimum entry requirements and minimum CGPA 2.50 are maintained
tuition.derived_range_note: No absolute MYR discount value is published because the rebate is a percentage of the programme tuition fee and APU does not publish per-programme figures on the scholarship page

monthly_stipend.note: Not published in any official source for this award

travel_allowance.note: Travel expenses are explicitly listed among the expenses borne by the award holder

installation_allowance.note: Not published in any official source for this award

visa_support.note: Not part of the award. The separate RM 3,600 Pre-Arrival Application Processing Fee includes EMGS visa processing fees, APU/APIIT application and processing fees, airport assistance and transfer to the university, and accommodation upon first arrival, but this fee is a student payment, not scholarship funding

insurance.note: Not covered by the award; APU provides separate insurance information for its international students

research_allowance.note: Not applicable at undergraduate level for this award

book_allowance.note: Not published in official source; award limited to course/tuition fees

equipment_allowance.note: Not applicable / not published in official source

accommodation_support.note: Accommodation fees are explicitly listed as borne by the award holder. The first-arrival accommodation only appears inside the RM 3,600 Pre-Arrival Application Processing Fee, which is not scholarship funding.

bond.note: No bond or service obligation is published. The reciprocal obligation is repayment: recipients who fail to comply with all terms and conditions of the Awards will be required to pay back in full the total value awarded by APU.

total_estimated_value.note: Not published as a total value; the award is a percentage rebate on tuition fees for each academic year

coverage: Reduction of course/tuition fees by 10%, 20% or 30% for each academic year, according to the qualification band in the official discount table
The 30% band applies to A-Levels AAA, O-Levels/IGCSE 8-9 As, IB Diploma 34 points and above, and IB MYP 48 points and above
The 20% band applies to A-Levels AAB, O-Levels/IGCSE 6-7 As, IB Diploma 30-33 points, and IB MYP 44-47 points
The 10% band applies to A-Levels ABB/AAC, O-Levels/IGCSE 4-5 As, IB Diploma 26-29 points, and IB MYP 35-43 points
Coverage is granted on a yearly basis and renewed on maintaining minimum CGPA 2.50
coverage_limitations: Coverage is capped at 30% of course tuition fees; there is no full-fee waiver band in the international table

Awards are limited to course/tuition fees only - registration fees, accommodation fees, deposits, partner university fees, resit or retake fees, living expenses and travel costs are excluded and borne by the award holder
Awards are applicable for studies at APU in Malaysia only and are not applicable for study at overseas partner universities
Awards are not transferable or exchangeable for cash either in part or in full
Securing the award requires paying the RM 3,600 Application & Processing Fees, which is non-refundable once the offer has been accepted (a real cost to the applicant, not scholarship income)

eligibility.citizenship: Open to all countries and nationalities - the official page states the award 'is applicable to all countries / nationalities'

APU allows undergraduate applicants to apply with forecast results initially, but award applications must fulfil the award academic entry requirements with actual results.
eligibility.academic_requirements: Actual final results in the 2026/2027 results set within one of the published bands. 'All the Award Applications must fulfil the Award Academic Entry Requirements with actual results.' Minimum entry requirements for the programme applied for must also be met.
eligibility.gpa_requirement: No entry CGPA/GPA threshold is published for the award (the bands are score bands on the school-leaving qualification). To keep the award in subsequent years, recipients must maintain a minimum CGPA of 2.50 at the end of each academic year.
eligibility.language_requirement: Not published for this award. APU's international application procedure generally requires copies of IELTS/TOEFL results to evaluate English language proficiency and IELTS/TOEFL/PTE/MUET certification results are listed among the documents needed for the student pass, but no score threshold is published for the scholarship itself.

eligibility.extracurricular_requirement: Sports Excellence at the level of the Olympics, SEA Games, Youth Olympics, Asian Games, World Cups or Commonwealth Games can be considered for merit awards on a case-by-case basis; it is not a requirement
eligibility.previous_scholarship_restriction: No restriction published on holding other external scholarships; however an award holder must comply with all APU terms and conditions
eligibility.enrolment_status_requirement: New international students only - the award is offered to new international students on a first-come, first-served basis
eligibility.health_requirement: Applicants must furnish a signed Health Declaration Form as part of the international student pass process; this is a general international application requirement rather than a scholarship criterion
eligibility.field_restrictions: Awards apply across APU programmes, with the bands defined by the entry qualification. The APU Scholarships & Financial Aids overview states that both Malaysian and International Merit Scholarships are applicable for Pre-U, Undergraduate and Postgraduate programmes.

application_method.application_route: Fill in the 'APU International Students Scholarships & Merit Awards' online form on the official page (which requires applicant name, gender, date of birth, nationality, residential city and country, email, mobile/WhatsApp, course interested, current qualification and educational documents/certificates). General admission is submitted separately through admissions.apu.edu.my. Questions go to scholarship@apu.edu.my.
application_steps: 1. Complete the APU international student application (Apply Now at admissions.apu.edu.my), indicating the programme and intake date, with certified copies of academic qualifications and English proficiency evidence
2. Receive the Letter of Offer if the eligibility criteria are met
3. Submit the APU International Students Scholarships & Merit Awards online form with the required educational documents/certificates
4. Pay the RM 3,600 (approx. USD 950) Application & Processing Fees together with the acceptance of the offer to secure the fee award

5. Furnish the supporting documents required for the student pass: passport photographs, all pages of a passport valid for at least 24 months from the intake date, certified academic certificates, Health Declaration Form, IELTS/TOEFL/PTE/MUET results, and a No Objection Certificate/LOE where applicable
application_method.application_fee: RM 3,600 (approx. USD 950) charged as Application & Processing Fees / Pre-Arrival Application Processing Fees. It covers EMGS visa processing fees and applicable EMGS GST, the APU/APIIT Application & Processing Fees, airport assistance and transfer to the university, and accommodation upon first arrival in Malaysia. It is non-refundable once the offer has been accepted, and paying it is how the fee award is secured.

Institution chosen: APU International Students Scholarships & Merit Awards, apu.edu.my.

DEADLINE CORRECTION: the brief asked to verify 'APU: 31 August 2026'. The official page currently states 'The deadline for this International Scholarship & Merit Awards is 31 October 2026'. 31 August 2026 is not the current official date and has not been recorded.

The RM 3,600 (approx. USD 950) Application & Processing Fees is an important student cost and is disclosed in the description, conditions, coverage limitations, risk flags, application fee, funding breakdown and student rights sections. It is the payment that secures the award, is non-refundable once the offer is accepted, and is not scholarship funding.

The official discount table has been captured exactly, including the exact qualification labels used by APU: 'A-Levels', 'O-Levels/IGCSE', 'International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma' and 'International Baccalaureate Middle Years Programme (IB MYP)', with the header 'Minimum Score in 2026/2027 Final Results' and column 'APU Merit Awards'.

The Malaysian-student table in the official APU Scholarships & Merit Award Guide (Aug 2026) shows different and higher percentages (for example IB Diploma 40/30/20/10%, STPM 50/35/20%). Those figures were deliberately NOT used for this record, which covers international students only; the Malaysian table was consulted only for the general terms and conditions.

The general terms and conditions in the official Aug 2026 guide were used to confirm the same principles: first-come, first-served awards secured on payment of the enrolment fee, minimum CGPA 2.50 renewal (3.70 for 100% discounts), non-transferability, tuition-only coverage, exclusion of registration/accommodation/deposit/partner-university/resit/living/travel costs, repayment on breach, and Malaysia-only applicability.

The award applies across Pre-U, Undergraduate and Postgraduate programmes; because this database is bachelor-level, the record is scoped to undergraduate entry and notes the Pre-U/Postgraduate reach explicitly.

The record is scoped to the international-student table only. The RM 3,600 fee is described on APU's International Students Application Procedures page as 'Pre-Arrival Application Processing Fees', which is the same figure the scholarship page calls 'Application & Processing Fees'; both wordings are recorded.

English-language requirement: no threshold exists for the award. This is recorded as an unverified item rather than filled with a figure, and the general IELTS/TOEFL/PTE/MUET evidence requirement for the international application and student pass is documented separately.
